description.en: Directed an engineering team of 6 developers, establishing technical roadmaps, architectural standards, and unblocking delivery across multiple enterprise releases.

description.nl: Leidde een team van 6 ontwikkelaars, stelde technische roadmaps en architectuurnormen vast en deblokkeerde opleveringen.

description.en: Engineered maintainable software designed for long-term ROI, prioritizing system resilience, Clean Architecture, and measurable business outcomes.
